what: When a large English title group reaches 75% of the screen, letters appear one by one rising from below by their own height at .08s intervals over .5s (a curve overshooting 6% at the end and settling), and the underline, subtitle and description rise from 30px below at .2, .3 and .4s over 1s with power2.out. Once only

options.dur: Time for one letter to rise (sec), default .5 — subpage headers .6
options.rise: Rise distance (% of text height), default 100
options.shift: Distance (px) that the underline, subtitle and description float up, default 30
options.ease: Text curve — a 「0.16,1,0.3,1」 form, an SVG path or a GSAP name, default is the original overshoot curve
options.on: ‹load› starts right away without waiting for the screen (after delay seconds) — subpage header band
options.delay: Start delay (sec), default 0 — .5 for subpage headers
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Large title to split into letters (required)
options.[data-fx-part=sub]·[data-fx-part=desc]: Subtitle · description — fade in .1s later each, in order (optional)
options.fade: If none, opacity is left alone and the text only rises — for when the title box hides overflowing letters with overflow: hidden (brand: each .05 · dur .4 · ease power2.out · rise 100 · start center center+=25%)
